channel.title: The Car Jury, News
channel.description: News and verdicts on the Indian car market from The Car Jury.

item.title: Tata Punch Flex-Fuel Spied Near Pune: Bharat Expo 2027 Reveal Likely
item.description: A camouflaged Tata Punch mule testing near Pune points to a flex-fuel variant, likely bound for a Bharat Mobility Expo 2027 reveal.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: Hyundai Smart Care Clinic: Free 50-Point Check, Up To 30% Off Labour Till Dec 8
item.description: Hyundai's Smart Care Clinic runs Nov 24 to Dec 8, 2026 across 1,700+ service centres with a free 50-point check and discounts on labour and parts.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: MG Windsor Facelift Needs More Than A Bigger Battery To Reclaim Its Lead
item.description: MG Windsor facelift expected in 2027 with a larger 61 kWh battery as sales slip behind Mahindra XEV 9S and Tata Punch EV. The Car Jury's verdict inside.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: 4.5-5m SUV Sales Oct 2026: Mahindra Takes Nearly 68% Of The Segment
item.description: India's 4.5-5m SUV segment grew 24.96% in October 2026 to 53,618 units, with Mahindra's Scorpio, XUV7XO and XEV 9S locking the top three.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.description: India's 4.2-4.5m SUV segment grew 20.5% in October 2026 to 94,940 units. Creta leads but Maruti Victoris is now within striking distance.

item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: Toyota Sales Slide 27% in October: Hyryder and Hycross Lead a Shrinking Lineup
